# Historiographical Tradition 1: Chronographia (Byzantine / Nova Elysia / Orthodox / Hellenic)

	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
		has_or_had_tag = ELR
		culture = culture:oe_elysian_greek
		AND = {
			exists = religion
			OR = {
				religion = religion:orthodox
				religion = religion:miaphysite
				religion = religion:nestorianism
				religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}

		culture = {
			OR = {
				has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:south_slavic_group
			}
		}
	}
}
